topic: Representation loss
hypothesis: Invariant canonicalization improves all tasks
finding: False: SyntheticControl discriminative mean/trend; raw versus canonical clean Macro-F1 about 0.931 vs 0.622 in dual-path studies
control: Retain exact raw/mean/slope/scale path, never force shape-only representation
verification: Raw/canonical dual and concept ablation on completely new tasks

topic: Overoptimized small-sample hyperparameters
hypothesis: Optuna TPE produces universal performance improvement
finding: HPO MESA clean mean 0.777 vs fixed MESA 0.806 on eight dataset benchmark; jitter 0.725 vs 0.705
control: Limit search degrees of freedom, nested TRAIN validation, require independent holdout
verification: Compare predeclared simple candidate with full HPO on fresh archives

topic: Mechanism supervision is not classification generalization
hypothesis: Accurate analytic concepts guarantee superior Macro-F1
finding: Mechanism-aligned concept RMSE about 0.113 vs 0.551, but fixed fusion clean Macro-F1 0.870 vs zero-loss 0.872
control: Always compare mechanism-on/zero-loss paired seed architectures, and report concept fidelity separately
verification: Real domain concept targets and paired classification

topic: Mean-slope chart blind to waveform noise
hypothesis: One Hotelling-type mean/slope chart detects every perturbation
finding: Fish and Car waveform jitter collapsed compact MultiRocket while mean/slope alarm did not switch appropriately
control: Keep independent waveform morphology chart and chart false-alarm audit
verification: New perturbation families with signal-level alarms, misses, F1 and no TEST tuning

topic: Performance attribution to MESA
hypothesis: MESA hybrid improvement must be due to learned neural features
finding: Kernel selector often gives zero MESA weight, leaving existing MultiRocket alone
control: Archive nonzero feature weights and matched generic encoder; do not claim attribution for zero weight
verification: Paired ablations with frozen feature contribution and information attribution

topic: Hard chart routing causes collateral losses
hypothesis: A fixed chart threshold preserves normal and affine performance automatically
finding: BioPhysics Risk-Gated 5-shot jitter +0.13491 versus dual episodic, clean -0.00955 and affine -0.02703 on independent four datasets
control: Apply HCLM noninferiority limits for clean and affine BEFORE declaring any new chart policy admissible
verification: TRAIN-only calibration of decision uncertainty on new fixed archive, paired risk-constrained acceptance

topic: Fixed expert fusion includes harmful priors
hypothesis: More physics and Hopfield components always increase performance
finding: Five-shot BioPhysics full and unconditional fusion often worse than Dual MR, with uneven class relevance
control: No unconditional expert addition; component must pass marginal train-only benefit/risk test
verification: Individual component ablation, cost and per-shift negative transfer

topic: Sparse DG codes are not guaranteed discriminative
hypothesis: k-WTA pattern separation automatically improves every task
finding: Sparse DG sometimes reduced Macro-F1 relative to less-complex cortical or MR episodic features
control: Allow zero DG weight and monitor class collision/sparsity on TRAIN
verification: Random expansion density and separation versus supervised outcomes

topic: Transformer architecture may learn poorly with few labels
hypothesis: Concept-routed attention necessarily beats CNN
finding: Early RouterFormer smoke failed Fish waveform jitter; convolutional MESA baseline substantially stronger with same short training
control: Make CNN and ordinary dense Transformer fixed-budget comparators before changing architecture
verification: Matched 12 epoch full-architecture experiments on untouched archives

topic: 1-shot model selection impossible by ordinary LOO
hypothesis: One support per class permits leave-one-label-out hyperparameter selection
finding: Removing its only labeled sample removes an entire class, yielding invalid class-preserving CV
control: Fixed 1-shot decision and no claimed train-validated superior expert
verification: Nested 1/3/5-shot protocol with valid abstention from selection

topic: Sequential claim from independent classification cases
hypothesis: Time-series dataset classification establishes SPC ARL0
finding: Synthetic per-case UCR studies have no chronological process stream and thus cannot measure run length
control: No ARL0, ARL1 or detection-delay statements without separate chronological streaming benchmarks
verification: Independent in-control/out-of-control streams and proper ARL evaluation

topic: Weak baseline and fairness gap
hypothesis: Beating compact 336-kernel MultiRocket establishes SOTA
finding: Matched full MultiRocket, Hydra+MultiRocket, TS2Vec, TimeMAE and MOMENT have not all been evaluated on the newest BioPhysics tasks
control: Required full comparator audit before any broad claim
verification: Identical UCR splits, seeds, label budgets, tuning budgets and hardware for strong baseline

topic: Repeated holdout inspection consumes independence
hypothesis: A dataset remains unseen after repeated architecture changes respond to its TEST performance
finding: Several datasets moved from initial holdout to development through repeated inspections
control: Every previously inspected TEST becomes development; future confirmation must freeze new datasets/seeds FIRST
verification: Immutable experiment contract and source-commit provenance for fresh holdout

topic: Too few datasets and random seeds
hypothesis: Four datasets and two seeds prove broad superiority
finding: Uncertainty can be large and negative transfer visible on individual domains
control: Paired clustered uncertainty intervals, no population claim; demand >=8 new tasks and >=5 paired seeds
verification: Predeclared repeated experiments, multiple-comparison budget

topic: Online loss bound conflated with static F1
hypothesis: Bayesian regret bound ensures higher Macro-F1
finding: Cumulative prequential log-loss upper bound ln K does not guarantee pointwise Macro-F1 or static evaluation improvement
control: Separate online/causal label-feedback protocol from static UCR experiments
verification: Audit appropriate metric and after-prediction label reveal

topic: Physical analogies overclaimed
hypothesis: Heat semigroup and AR2 predictive prior are verified governing laws for all UCR sensors
finding: Contractive analytical signal operators are useful priors but not validated physical mechanisms
control: Label priors as mathematical regularizers until real-world physical constraints verified
verification: Domain-specific interventions and causal concept truth

topic: Dataset-level sample count is not enough for few-shot eligibility
hypothesis: Dataset total TRAIN/class metadata implies at least 5 examples for every class
finding: FaceFour and Adiac both failed load_data TRAIN class-frequency threshold despite plausible aggregate counts; no TEST scoring took place
control: Check min TRAIN count by actual class before scheduling any few-shot experiment; document ineligible tasks without swapping them in response to TEST performance
verification: TRAIN-only aeon archive counts, exact preregistered exclusion report

topic: Shallow GitHub Actions checkouts invalidate historical git-diff reference tests
hypothesis: The pinned pretest source commit is always available locally via git diff in CI
finding: First frozen ElasticSynapse holdout run failed all jobs during source provenance check because checkout@v4 used a shallow clone; zero TEST scores were computed
control: Pin exact git blob SHA-1 of model source and verify via git hash-object; document CI-only amendment, never alter frozen model during repair
verification: Compare immutable source file SHA from pretest commit and current branch, test CI without loading TEST before repairing

topic: Strong 10k MultiRocket baseline must be matched, not cited from another dataset
hypothesis: A compact 336-kernel baseline provides robust SOTA evidence
finding: Full 10000-kernel features were successfully evaluated on ArrowHead, SwedishLeaf and ScreenType; new architecture must be compared on the same datasets, support IDs and perturbation family
control: Match complete baseline implementation and label IDs to new architecture's frozen validation, retain all negative results
verification: HCLM matched 10k MR benchmark on CricketX, MedicalImages, Worms and Yoga with seed 3801/3802

topic: A new OOD detector can erase stronger existing nuisance detection
hypothesis: Adding a second feature-space novelty monitor and dividing chart alpha always improves noise routing
finding: Development Fish/Car/MedicalImages: 5-shot representation-surprise router jitter mean 0.2883 versus original 0.3864 (delta -0.0981); MedicalImages improved +0.068 but Car missed all waveform alerts and lost 0.362 jitter Macro-F1 relative to old route.
control: Never replace a detector solely because one stressor improves. HCLM must require a paired multivariate dev risk gate and verify per-domain misses; keep original detector as best verified sandbox. Do not rerun old TEST datasets to claim fresh superiority.
verification: Risk-calibrated two-chart union with no wrong-scope Bonferroni change, frozen independent external validation of future alternative
